data.description: This belt has a large platinum buckle, usually depicting the image of a titan. The belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to all physical ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution) of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.
data.name: Belt of Physical Perfection +2

raw_tokens.value: Construction Requirements|Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, bull's strength, cat's grace
